data.data_quality_notes: No gross prioryear movement figure is disclosed in the notes. The only quantified prioryear movements are presented as net (after reinsurance) in the 'Claims outstanding' note (labelled 'Material over provisions...' and the 'Release/(strengthening)' table). Prior-year movement therefore uses the net figure (-GBP 0.172m) and is flagged accordingly. Line-of-business mappings for the small class-level movements are approximate and derived from the net table; amounts shown by class are net and not gross.
